scoring_justification: Checker recomputes analytic R_c and R_s from formulas and compares each row within absolute tolerance.

outputs.description: Angular distribution functions R_c and R_s evaluated for a prescribed set of orthotropic parameters κ and angles θ.

output_contract.notes: The agent must not simply copy the paper's figures; it must recompute the formulas. The hidden checker will independently evaluate the same analytic expressions and compare each row within a tolerance.

steps.check_description: Recompute expected R_c and R_s for every row using the analytic formulas; score = fraction of rows where both R_c and R_s absolute errors are ≤ tolerance.
